_doc: Per-category PIT policy metadata (plan §6-§7; POL-01..06). archive_start_at / policy_effective_at are configuration, never hardcoded. Classes are set by the audit report; 'UNVERIFIED' until evidence exists.

rule.definition: available_at = the NSE results-listing broadcast time (broadCastDate / broadcast_Date, second precision) of the earliest ORIGINAL filing for (symbol, period); filings whose submission time is > 15 min after the broadcast (AV-1 contradiction) or that have no broadcast time (flagged revisions) are excluded
rule.validation_coverage: PIT audit sample: 40 stocks x 8 quarters (Sep-24..Jun-26), legacy + integrated formats; BSE cross-check on 502 filings (BSE earlier by >15 min in 472, within 15 min in 24, later in 6); 4 contradictions -> excluded
rule.conservative_because: the NSE broadcast is itself a public dissemination time and was never earlier than the BSE results announcement in the sample beyond 15 min except 6 cases where NSE was first; it can delay availability, not advance it
rule.approval_scope: results broadcast times in the NSE listing archive for all symbols, Oct 2024 - Sep 2026, used by the positional pre-registration arm D1 (research only; model training needs separate approval)
